A contrastive-learning dataset for training and evaluating domain-adapted text embedding models for Korean Medicine (KM, 한의학). Each example is a query–positive–negatives triplet built from Korean Medicine terminology dictionaries and a curated KM ontology, capturing clinically meaningful semantic relations such as disease–symptom, disease–pattern, pattern–prescription, prescription–efficacy, and herb–indication.

		통계
